name: jmusicbot
description: A Discord music bot that's easy to set up and run yourself! Note: the image was changed to ghcr.io/arif-banai/musicbot, as the previous image stopped working. To start, run once, then modify config.txt with the owner Discord ID and Discord Bot token. Restart the container to use new settings.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Directory where config.txt and serversettings.json are held.

variables.name: Java Options
variables.description: JVM memory options for the bot (e.g. max/min heap size).
